status: Source semantics and reproducible preliminary georeferencing prepared; not approved annual political geometry

source.institution: Digital South Asia Library, University of Chicago
source.bibliography: Joseph E. Schwartzberg (ed.), A Historical Atlas of South Asia, second impression with additional material, Oxford University Press, 1992
source.titleAsPrinted: Mauryas and contemporaneous powers, c.325–175 B.C.
source.periodNote: This submap title spans c.325–175 BCE, while the parent plate/catalog says 321–181 BCE. Neither is a single dated extent.

title.zh: 前305年之后：塞琉古割让领土

explanation.zh: 西北部的标注线说明塞琉古一世向旃陀罗笈多割让的领土界限。它记录一组割让范围，不能单独作为该年孔雀王朝的完整国界。
explanation.en: The northwestern line identifies territory ceded by Seleucus I to Chandragupta. Read it as a cession boundary within the wider reconstruction.

title.zh: 至前273年：南部领土已并入

explanation.zh: 南部图注明确保留两种归属可能：这些地区由旃陀罗笈多或宾头沙罗取得，至前273年已经加入孔雀王朝。图版未把取得时间固定在前273年。
explanation.en: The southern annotation attributes acquisition to either Chandragupta or Bindusara, with incorporation completed by 273 BCE. The acquisition year and ruler remain unresolved.

readingSections.classification: acquired by one of two rulers; latest stated incorporation date

explanation.zh: 东海岸附近的箭注指向约前260年被阿育王征服的区域。沿这条线阅读此次扩张，并与其他时期、其他线型分开对照。
explanation.en: The eastern coastal annotation marks an area conquered by Ashoka around 260 BCE. Compare this expansion with the separately dated boundaries on the same map.

title.zh: 阿育王在位期间：取得或殖入的地区
title.en: During Ashoka’s reign: acquisition or colonization

explanation.zh: 北方的另一组箭注以阿育王在位期间为时间范围，并同时使用取得与殖入两种表述。需要保持这种范围和性质上的区别。
explanation.en: A separate northern annotation covers acquisition or colonization during Ashoka’s reign. Preserve both the reign-level timing and the distinction between those processes.

cartographicSpecifications.scaleCaution: The standard scale is for the atlas base; do not assign it to this reduced inset without measuring its scale factor. The source describes multiple reduction factors.

georeferencing.reason: Printed conic family/datum unspecified; preliminary manual edge controls contain a large residual and two independent location checks are 58–69 km apart from the fitted scan. Digitization must not be represented as a precise historic boundary yet.

sourceUseFacts.fact: General DSAL maps page permits downloading/viewing for private study and instructs attribution; it distinguishes image linking from reproduction in a hypertext document.

The atlas-specific catalog retains a copyright notice assigning the original rights to Joseph E. Schwartzberg and asks prior written permission for storage or reproduction. It does not identify an open redistribution license.

integrationRecommendation: Add the four bilingual dated reading notes to the existing scholarly reference card; link the institution image/viewer. Keep the local raster and calibration experiment as research inputs. Do not replace annual political polygons or infer reign-wide extents.
